kv15.10:1.3: Atthi saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpannassa alobho kusalamūlaṃ, adoso kusalamūlaṃ, amoho kusalamūlaṃ, saddhā viriyaṃ sati samādhi paññā ti?
kv15.10:1.5: N' atthi saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpannassa alobho kusalamūlaṃ --pe-- paññā ti?
kv15.10:1.7: Hañci n' atthi paññā, no vata re vattabbe
kv15.10:2.3: Atthi saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpannassa phasso vedanā saññā cetanā cittan ti?
kv15.10:2.5: N' atthi saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpannassa phasso vedanā saññā cetanā cittan ti?
kv15.10:2.7: Aphassakassa maggabhāvanā, avedanakassa maggabhāvanā --pe-- acittakassa maggabhāvanā ti?
kv15.10:2.9: Nanu saphassakassa maggabhāvanā --pe-- sacittakassa maggabhāvanā ti?
kv15.10:2.12: sacittakassa maggabhāvanā, no vata re vattabbe
kv15.10:3.3: ye keci saññāvedayitanirodhaṃ samāpajjanti, sabbe te asaññasattūpikā ti?
kv15.10:4.4: Nanu idhāpi asaññī tatrāpi asaññī ti?
kv15.10:4.6: Hañci idhāpi asaññī tatrāpi asaññī, tena vata re vattabbe
